## Activity

During April 2022, Market Eye Clinic recorded 363 captures. This activity represents the total number of image captures completed at the site during the month. The results provide the basis for the image quality review and subsequent grading activity.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 15 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.1 per cent. This measure indicates the proportion of images that could not be assessed for grading purposes. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk to support follow-up and resolution.

## Grading

Grading identified 75 referable results. The median lag from image capture to completion of grading was 20 days. These results should be considered alongside the image quality findings, including the 15 ungradable captures and the ungradable rate of 4.1 per cent. Monitoring the time from capture to grading remains relevant to the review of site operations.
